ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 253 Section I is the Honors section for MCB Honors students and James Scholars. Concurrent registration in MCB 298 A is required. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@illinois.edu for information and approval. Laboratories begin on Monday, August 24, 2009. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7-9 PM on October 20, 2009 and December 1, 2009. Enrollment in this course is restricted to Sophmores, Juniors and Seniors. To be considered for an override as a Freshman, please contact Deb Bielser at bielser@life.illinois.edu.
